# OrbitControls

`orbit-controls.js` is the unmodified Three.js r160 OrbitControls example
(`three@0.160.0`, `examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js`) from
[mrdoob/three.js](https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r160), under the MIT
license. The demo shell currently has no imports of this example.
